notes.pool_target: >= 7,800 candidate rows so the 5,000-row main arm survives the 0.8 train split and an 0.8 training-side retention; per-family arithmetic in the P71 plan (split rule x feasible surface x 4 rows/shard)
notes.feasible_surface: v2 measured every FEASIBLE cell to complete; the v2 attrition was systematic, not random: depth-1@8192 is infeasible for all families (K=20 + distractor floor), F-families reject depth 3, join_lookup loses depth-2@32k. This grid schedules only the measured-feasible cells, so infeasible.json should come back empty and any entry is a regression to investigate
notes.worlds_per_cell_by_family: absorbs the per-family differences: rule_holdout's structure split sends a whole structure to eval (needs 42 x 6 cells = 252 shards for 1,000 rows), alias/asof live on a 3-cell surface (84 worlds/cell), records families on 5 cells
notes.world_seed_base: 760000 is far from v2's 710000 (seed = base + plan index; overlapping ranges would collide world_ids across banks)
notes.families: join_unanswerable rides the B4 adapter (commit 1356f88); set_complete rides the B2 family (in flight at config-writing time — generation holds until both are registered in FAMILY_MODULES)
